# apple_bundle_ids (Data Source)

Lists the bundle IDs that match every given filter.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_bundle_ids" "ios" {
  platforms = ["IOS"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `identifiers` (Set of String) Bundle identifiers to match.
- `names` (Set of String) Names to match.
- `platforms` (Set of String) Platforms to match. Values: `IOS`, `MAC_OS`, `UNIVERSAL`.
- `seed_ids` (Set of String) App ID prefixes to match.

### Read-Only

- `bundle_ids` (Attributes List) The matching bundle IDs, ordered by ID. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--bundle_ids))

<a id="nestedatt--bundle_ids"></a>
### Nested Schema for `bundle_ids`

Read-Only:

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the bundle ID.
- `identifier` (String) Bundle identifier.
- `name` (String) Name of the bundle ID.
- `platform` (String) Platform of the bundle ID.
- `seed_id` (String) App ID prefix.
